name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention and matches the sibling shop functions (fd2_run_buy_item_menu / fd2_run_equip_member_menu / fd2_run_give_item_menu). Name accurately reflects the function: the top-level loop for the SELL branch of the chapter-intro shop menu (dispatched at cursor idx 1 by fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main). No Ghidra address residue in the name.
purpose: Top-level loop for the SELL branch of the chapter-intro shop menu: pick a seller, list that member's inventory, pick an item, confirm, and sell it at 75% of base price.
logic_summary: Snapshots two short[6] per-shop-tier dialog text-id tables (sell_for @ 0x5272A, no_items @ 0x52736) into local arrays. Then loops: (1) set visible_item_count = party member count and run fd2_party_roster_single_select_loop to pick a seller (Esc / -1 returns); seller = cursor idx. (2) Build the seller's inventory id list across 8 slots, skipping slots whose flag byte has bit 0x80 (empty); append item id otherwise. (3) If empty, show the 'nothing to sell' reject dialog (no_items table) and loop back. (4) Reset cursor/scroll, open the sell-mode item panel (sell_mode=1 shows 75% price), run fd2_shop_menu_input_loop (sell_mode=1); Esc loops back. (5) On commit, read the chosen slot's item id via fd2_get_inventory_slot_item_id(seller, cursor), set last_action_sprite_id_param = item_id + 0xB5, fetch item entry, and compute sale price = (uint16 price @ item_entry+0x13) * 3 >> 2 (signed >>2, floors) into last_action_value_param. (6) Show the 'sell?' yes/no confirm (sell_for table); cancel / cursor==1 (no) loops back. On yes: transaction-feedback animation, money-increment animation of the sale price, remove the slot, recompute combat stats. Repeats forever until the seller-roster Esc.

returns.semantics: No return value; loops internally until the seller-roster select is cancelled (Esc / -1), then returns to fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main.

notes: Source comment in shop.c is already precise and matches the decompilation (char-first then item-first flow, 75% resale price*3>>2, two dialog tables at 0x5272A/0x52736, inline 8-slot inventory build skipping bit-0x80 empties, yes/no confirm with cursor==1=no, EAX-bug notes per call site); kept verbatim. Ghidra plate is detailed and consistent with the refined understanding (not contradictory/stale), so left untouched per the conservative rule. Minor plate imprecision (lists party_total_gold @0x53BF3 as 'Incremented on sale' under Globals touched, though the increment actually happens inside the fd2_animate_money_increment callee, not directly in this function) is not contradictory and the src comment correctly attributes the gold change to fd2_animate_money_increment, so no plate edit. Caller fd2_run_chapter_intro_menu_main @ 0x2E341 confirms dispatch at cursor idx 1 (SELL). reads/writes_globals exclude callee-side effects.
